Practical fabrication

Built For Industrial Fitment

Good fabrication is more than joining metal. The part has to fit the drawing, survive handling, allow assembly access and be practical to finish. We plan the sequence around how the component will be used, whether it is a one-off sample or a repeat production item.

Process Combination

Cutting, CNC punching, press brake bending, welding support and finishing coordination can be combined so fewer vendors are needed.

Drawing Review

We check bend allowances, hole positions, mounting points, material thickness and fabrication sequence before starting the job.

Local Coordination

Customers around Peenya, Sunkadakatte, Rajajinagar, Yeshwanthpur and Hegganahalli can coordinate samples and revisions quickly.
